# Issue #7: Fix the login redirect

## Goal
After login the user lands on the page they asked for.

## Context from PRD
PRD does not cover this. Which pages may be a redirect target?

## Acceptance criteria
- Login returns to the requested page
- An unknown target falls back to the home page

## Suggested tests
- Login from a deep page returns to it
- Login with no target opens the home page
- A target outside the app is ignored

## Related issues
None.

## Risks / open questions
An open redirect if the target is not checked.
